# Supplemental on_action hooks for Towards Victory
# Diplomatic and Cultural point accumulation hooks.

on_royal_marriage = {
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points add = 3 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points add = 3 }
		}
	}
}

on_winning_war = {
	effect = {
		scope:winner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_diplomatic_victory_points add = 5 }
		}
	}
}

on_work_of_art_created = {
	effect = {
		root.owner ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_cultural_influence_points }
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points add = 10 }
		}
	}
}
